thread.title: Apple, Salesforce Announce Strategic Partnership

title: Apple, Salesforce Announce Strategic Partnership
text: Apple, Salesforce Announce Strategic Partnership CUPERTINO (dpa-AFX) - Apple (AAPL) and Salesforce announced a strategic partnership. Salesforce, working with Apple, will redesign the Salesforce Mobile App, with Apple capabilities such as Siri Shortcuts, Face ID, Business Chat and more. Salesforce will also introduce the first ever Trailhead Mobile App, first on iOS. The rebuilt Salesforce Mobile App will be available in early 2019.Apple and Salesforce are developing the Salesforce Mobile SDK that is optimized for Swift, Apple's modern programming language. The new Salesforce Mobile SDK for iOS will be available by the end of 2018.Copyright RTT News/dpa-AFX
